title: A stack inside a repeat puts every copy at the last copy's place
close_reason: Fixed in 8d5c911. `Places` in `scene/build.rs` keys each stack or grid child's slot by the node's address, not its span, so copies a `repeat` makes no longer share one slot. `add_panel` draws its contents in place instead of from clones. Tests in `build.rs` cover stacks, grids, panels and nested stacks inside a repeat, and a stack holding a repeat.
